declared_gates.derivation: coupling v2 emits one ordered segment per accepted centreline minimum/null and derives wall-high/cusp-low loss-cone probability; the corrected global model accepts exactly four direct probabilities

topology.mirror_ratio: finite and >= 1; wall high field strictly exceeds positive cusp low field

failure_taxonomy.BOUNDARY_LEAKAGE: a selected cusp depended on a finite-domain boundary sample or margin
failure_taxonomy.CONFIDENCE_FAILURE: candidate, prominence, segment, or overall confidence failed
failure_taxonomy.COUPLING_REJECTED: coupling v2 rejected evidence or mirror projection
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_GATE_FAILURE: field residual, identity, source, or boundary gate failed
failure_taxonomy.FIELD_SOLVER_FAILURE: Warp field solve or strict L1a artifact validation failed
failure_taxonomy.GEOMETRY_INVALID: accepted geometry v1.1 construction or strict validation failed
failure_taxonomy.MIRROR_INVERTED: wall/cusp fields or mirror ratio were inverted, zero, or nonfinite
failure_taxonomy.ORDERING_FAILURE: segments or cusps were not strictly ordered and contiguous
failure_taxonomy.PARITY_FAILURE: selected CPU/Warp parity case exceeded the declared scale-relative gates
failure_taxonomy.PLASMA_NONCONVERGENCE: strict deterministic global-plasma multi-start found no residual root
failure_taxonomy.PROBABILITY_INVALID: coupling-v2 loss probability was nonfinite or outside [0,1)
failure_taxonomy.ROLE_MISMATCH: centreline or wall profile role/radius was invalid
failure_taxonomy.TOPOLOGY_COUNT: resolved coupling topology did not contain exactly four segments

limitations: L1a is a finite homogeneous-Dirichlet equivalent-current field model.
Topology is sampled-grid and uncertainty-gated, not a continuous proof.
Operating points are hypothetical and not experiment-calibrated.
Global plasma does not provide validated thrust, efficiency, or lifetime.
No uncontrolled timing or hardware-performance claim is made.
Coupling v2 used a deprecated same-z mirror proxy and roundoff null lows.
Residual roots are rank-deficient and are not identifiable plasma states.
model_chain: coupling v2 deprecated same-z mirror proxy

plasma_policy.outcome_classification: rank-deficient residual roots are non-identifiable screening-equation diagnostics only

invalidity_reasons: the search protocol and gates were not preregistered before execution
coupling v2 used the deprecated same-z centreline-low/wall-high mirror proxy
selected null lows are roundoff-scale and not physical mirror minima

supersession_required.requirement: both coupling v3 and a preregistered v2 search are required before physical mirror, identifiable-state, or performance claims
